interpretations: For each `event.status`, average the event-level mean of `budget.remaining` and the event-level mean of (`budget.spent` − `budget.amount`) ÷ `budget.amount`, using only budget lines matched to an event; divide the status’s average remaining by the equally weighted mean of the nonmissing status-level average remaining values. Ignore missing values in each average and do not round.
queries:
WITH event_means AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS mean_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS mean_spent_minus_amount_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_means AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(mean_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(mean_spent_minus_amount_ratio) AS avg_spent_minus_amount_ratio
    FROM event_means
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
    status,
    avg_remaining / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM status_means) AS normalized_avg_remaining,
    avg_spent_minus_amount_ratio
FROM status_means
